_comment: What a route card's title and the map's bottom bar call a terminus whose station name a traveller would not recognise as the city it serves. Titles and the bottom bar's chips only: URLs come from station-cities.json, and timetables, stop lists and the map keep the station's own name. Keep it short: a name that already says its city (Wien Hbf, Praha hl.n.) does not belong here.
